system.subject: Practo healthcare support agent
system.justification: Under the Low/Medium/High scheme (Low: summarization or transcription; Medium: code generation or customer-support tickets; High: medical data, hiring, or financial decisions), the system is High risk. Although most traffic is customer-support policy questions, it looks up patient appointment records tied to a medical specialty and answers questions near clinical topics such as prescriptions, lab results, and emergencies, where an unsupported answer could cause harm. The highest-risk capability sets the system level, which is why it is governed by least-autonomy tool permissions, input guardrails, grounded abstention, independent review, per-request budgets, and privacy-safe logging; it must not diagnose or recommend treatment.

components.subject: Knowledge-base retrieval (search_practo_knowledge_base)
components.justification: Answers patient-facing customer-support questions from project-authored policy documents. It reads no personal or appointment data, but an unsupported or wrong policy answer about fees, cancellations, or emergencies could mislead a patient, so it is guarded by calibrated abstention and an output groundedness check.

components.subject: Appointment lookup (check_appointment_status)
components.justification: Reads individual healthcare appointment records (medical specialty, status, fee, follow-up flag). Even though the dataset is synthetic, the tool models access to medical data, so it is read-only, restricted to the Lookup Agent, and its identifiers are excluded from logs.
